verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Sentry ships its own MCP server (mcp.sentry.dev) so other AI assistants can call Sentry's tools, and it can even monitor/observe MCP server traffic (docs-44) — but this is the reverse direction. There is no evidence that Sentry itself (or its Seer agent) can act as an MCP client and plug in external MCP servers to use their tools.
